Frequently Asked Questions
Are your animals 100% grass-fed and grass-finished?

Yes. Our beef and lamb are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished, meaning they consume no grain, soy, or other feed—and they only eat a variety of grasses and perennial plants we grow, with some hay supplement to support healthy digestion. Our pigs are pasture-raised and fed organic, non-GMO grains, along with grubs and wild forage.

STEMPLE CREEK SHARES

We offer whole and half Beef, Hog and Lamb shares for custom cut & wrap at one of our partner butchers.

SHOP ALL PRODUCTS
HOW IT WORKS

From reserving your animal to picking up your custom-cut order, the process is straightforward, transparent, and handled with care every step of the way.

STEP 1
RESERVE YOUR SHARE

Place your order online with a non-refundable deposit to reserve a whole or half beef, lamb, or hog. Timelines can vary depending on the season and processing schedules. Once harvested, the final hanging weight is confirmed and you’ll receive an invoice for the remaining balance.

STEP 2
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CUTS

Choose your preferred butcher— Bud’s Custom Meats (Penngrove) or Willowside Meats (Santa Rosa). The butcher will contact you directly to review cut and wrap options, packaging preferences, and timing. Custom cut and wrap fees are paid directly to the butcher at pickup.

STEP 3
FILL YOUR FREEZER & ENJOY

Once processing is complete, you’ll pick up your order directly from the butcher shop. Your meat will wrapped, labeled, and frozen—ready for long-term storage.

CUSTOM CUT & WRAP

We harvest 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef and lamb and pasture raised pigs seasonally.
